nodeData.note: Draft · index only — the shape of the library for review before any map is written. Renewable and eco energy for a student, a farmer or camp manager, and a minister: what we burn and what replaces it, the technologies, the combinations, the off-grid kit, and the proposal to government. Nothing nuclear. Every bubble will link to an official source with the date checked. Idea and direction: KKD's father.
